verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP requests to a running `cloudreve server` (master mode, sqlite + in-memory KV, local storage backend) over its /api/v4 interface, exactly as a browser / WOPI client / share recipient would send them

co_present_vulns.proof: GET /api/v4/user/search returns an account that an admin has set to status=inactive; after fix the inactive account is excluded (confirmed on C and on fix)

PUT /api/v4/file/content uploads a tiny PNG declaring 9000x9000 (81 MP); GET /api/v4/file/thumb decodes it (returns a thumbnail URL) on C; after fix the request is refused by a declared-dimension check before decode

POST /api/v4/file/wopi/:id with X-WOPI-Override: PUT_RELATIVE and X-WOPI-SuggestedTarget 'a/../../pwned.txt' writes a file one directory above the edited file's folder on C; after fix a target containing path separators is rejected (400, X-WOPI-InvalidFileNameError)
GET /api/v4/file/wopi/:id?access_token=<sessionid>.<wrong-secret> returns full file info (200) on C; after fix the full token is constant-time compared and a forged secret yields 403

GET /api/v4/file/events?uri=cloudreve://<id>@share on a single-file share opens the folder-scoped SSE stream (connection held open) on C; after fix the single-file-view subscription is refused with a no-permission error

dropped_vulns.reason: remote-download SSRF needs a configured downloader node (aria2/slave) that actually fetches the URL, and the node-test SSRF path is gated behind the OAuth authorization-code + scoped-token flow; neither is practical to drive deterministically offline
requires registering an OAuth client and completing the authorization-code flow to obtain a scope-limited token; heavy setup, not reached by ordinary session auth
a 3.x-era advisory (fixed by 3.6.0-beta1); not co-present on the v4 codebase at C
could not pin the scoped-DAV broken-access-control fix to a single reachable commit near C within budget; dropped to keep the stack reliably reproducible

verified.offline: no network after image build: sqlite database + in-memory KV, local storage backend; the frontend SPA is stubbed (API-only). Verified the server boots and all flows work with no external services.
verified.project_tests_run: no suitable offline Go unit tests for the affected HTTP handlers; coverage is provided by the functional group driving the real server (login, upload/list, active-user search, normal-image thumbnail, editor with valid token + bare-name save-as, own-folder event subscription)
verified.build: pure-Go (CGO_ENABLED=0, modernc.org/sqlite); first image build ~14 min / image 4.36 GB; verifier rebuild from /app is incremental ~9 s against the baked module+build cache
